_about: Non-code files the frontend build embeds in nhl-studio.exe (receipt 46), and what is recorded about their rights. `rights` = 'first-party' (Studio-owned, covered by Studio's licence), 'third-party' (licence named in `terms`), or 'unrecorded'. Only a recorded user / coordinator answer may change an 'unrecorded' row; the assembler never infers one. Any unrecorded file keeps the candidate from being release-ready.
